title: Final CEO Advert
text:
We are
CHIEF EXECUTIVE OFFICER (CEO)-Securities and Exchange Commission of
Zimbabwe (SECZIM)
Location: Harare, Zimbabwe
Reporting To: Board of Directors/Commissioners
Employment Type: Full-Time | Executive Management
Role Purpose
The Chief Executive Officer (CEO) is responsible for providing overall strategic leadership, executive management, and direction of the
Commission. The CEO will ensure the effective implementation of Board-approved strategies, sound corporate governance, financial sustainability,
operational efficiency, and stakeholder confidence while driving long-term growth and impact
Key Responsibilities
a) Leads the development and execution of the Commission’s Results Based Strategic plan, ensuring alignment with the Commission’s vision and objectives.
b) Provides overall leadership of the Commission’s operations, performance, and resources to achieve agreed targets.
c) Recommends appropriate policy proposals to the Government concerning capital markets.
d) Ensures strong corporate governance, risk management, compliance, and ethical standards across the Commission.
e) Reviews the quarterly Prudential and AML/CFT/PF compliance report.
f) Develops the organization’s financial strategy and ensures that it is implemented.
g) Ensures annual budget is approved by the Board and the Ministry of Finance, Economic Development and Investment.
h) Develops and ensures implementation of the Client Service Charter.
i) Builds and maintains effective relationships with key stakeholders, including regulators, partners, funders, shareholders, and the public.
j) Develops and ensures the implementation of investor education and awareness strategies whilst also making policy recommendations to the Ministry of Finance,
Economic Development and Investment Promotion.
k) Evaluates and approves all procurements for the Commission.
l) Leads, mentors, and manages the Senior Management team, fostering a high-performance and accountable culture.
m) Administers the Commissions affairs, funds and properties.
n) Controls and supervises the Commission’s staff.
o) Oversees performance management for the Commission.
p) Oversees Commission policies, systems, and controls to ensure efficiency, transparency, and accountability.
q) Implements any Board approved structural changes, as well as ensuring the Commission is adequately staffed.
r) Represents the Commission at strategic levels, i.e. to Ministry of Finance, Economic Development and Investment Promotion, AfDB, World Bank.
s) Exercises any other function that may be conferred or imposed upon him/her by or under the Securities and Exchange Act
Qualifications & Experience
� Bachelor’s degree in Business, Management, Economics, Finance, or a related discipline
� A Master’s degree (MBA or equivalent)
� Minimum of 10 years’ senior management experience, with at least 5 years at executive leadership level
� Proven track record in strategic leadership and experience in capital markets
Core Competencies
� Strategic leadership and execution
� Corporate governance and risk management
� Financial and commercial acumen
� Stakeholder and Board engagement
� Strong communication, negotiation, and decision-making skills
How to Apply
Interested candidates should submit a detailed CV and cover letter demonstrating suitability for the role to may@hatchtalent.co.zw
Closing Date: 23 January 2026
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
